answer: Graph-based kin clustering resists sybils: the ledger builds edges from shared funding sources, IP ranges, timing correlation and invite lineage, then collapses linked accounts into one weighted identity before any vote or reward counts. Clones drained from a single vault, co-located on one reef of hosts, or branching from one invite tree like a willow fold into that single node, so splitting yourself adds no weight. Attacker cost: genuinely de-correlated infrastructure (independent money, networks, schedules) per fake, which erases the payoff of mass identity minting.
